actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, brows, and conditional facial hair: strongly receding bare upper forehead, short dark brown/black hair at back and sides, distinct dark brow hair, and a small dark upper-lip moustache with a clean chin. Maintain the mild closed-mouth expression and slightly turned bust angle. Keep the dark navy/blue open-lapel coat over a broad pale grey/white high-collar shirt front as actually visible, with no conventional dark necktie, cravat, or bow. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve the actual open garment structure and coherent front/rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque dark purple/grey photographic backing, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct where they are in the source.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded slightly turned bust with actual source angle and mild CLOSED-MOUTH expression. Strongly receding/bare upper forehead with short DARK BROWN/BLACK hair at back/sides, real dark brow HAIR and distinct small DARK UPPER-LIP MOUSTACHE, clean chin. Dark NAVY/blue OPEN-lapel coat over a broad PALE GREY/WHITE HIGH-COLLAR shirt front as actually visible, no conventional dark necktie visible. Preserve that real pale cloth front, do not mistake it for mascot belly; no invented cravat/bow. No cap or spectacles. Keep the dark PURPLE/GREY photographic backing inside frame, not a generic pale-grey replacement.
Mascot eyes must be green-ringed black eyes. Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
